# `Q-5-57` — About Pages Not Yet Supported

> A website or book page sets `about:`. Quarto 2 does not implement about page
> templates yet; the page renders as a plain document.

## What this means

In Quarto 1, a page of a website or book that sets `about:` in its
front matter is laid out as an about page: one of the built-in
templates (`jolla`, `trestles`, `solana`, `marquee`, `broadside`)
places the page's image, title, and links around its content.

```yaml
---
title: "Finley Malloc"
image: profile.jpg
about:
  template: jolla
  links:
    - icon: github
      text: GitHub
      href: https://github.com
---
```

Quarto 2 does not implement these templates. The `about:` key is
ignored and the page renders like any other page of the site: the
title block and body appear, but not the profile image or the link
buttons.

The render succeeds; the warning reports a gap in this Quarto version.

## Why this happens

The website was migrated from Quarto 1, or started from a Quarto 1
template (the blog template ships an `about.qmd` that uses `jolla`).

## How to fix

There is no configuration that produces an about page layout in this
version. Your options are:

**Write the layout into the page.** Put the image and links in the
body with ordinary Markdown, and remove `about:`:

```markdown
![](profile.jpg){width=200}

[GitHub](https://github.com)
```

**Leave it as is.** The page still renders, without the about
layout. To keep `about:` for Quarto 1 and silence the warning in
Quarto 2, turn the diagnostic off in the page's front matter or in
`_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
diagnostics:
  Q-5-57:
    level: off
    reason: "about: is kept for Quarto 1"
```
